description: Delete one or more DevGlow workspaces by id. Removes the arrangement only: the processes that were in it keep running and stay in the sidebar (use delete_process / stop_project for those). The workspace the user is currently in is refused — deleting it would replace their screen. Delete only workspaces you created or the user asked you to remove; list_workspaces first.
name: delete_workspace

skipped_current.description: The workspace the user is in; never deleted over MCP.

title: Delete workspaces
